name: Del Monte Canned Sliced Carrots (Fork-Soft)
whyItWorks: Peeled, sliced, and fully pressure-cooked in the can. These carrots mash with gentle pressure from a fork, requiring zero digestive chewing energy and providing abundant soothing beta-carotene.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Heat briefly in a saucepan or microwave. Mash into white rice or eat as an easy side with baked chicken breast.
watchOuts: Safe for all phases of IBD, including active flares and strictures.
